meta.name: postgresql-table-design
meta.description: Use this skill when designing or reviewing a PostgreSQL-specific schema. Covers best-practices, data types, indexing, constraints, performance patterns, and advanced features

copy.tagline: 设计出规范高效的Postgres表结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在为应用设计或审查Postgres表结构,并希望用上实践验证过的方案
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing or reviewing PostgreSQL table schemas and want practical guidance.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 在设计或审查 PostgreSQL 表结构时,会按该技能的规则给出字段类型、主键、约束、索引与分区建议,并产出可直接使用的建表 SQL。
howto.when: 当你要求设计新的 PostgreSQL 表结构、审查已有 schema,或为字段选类型、加索引、决定是否分区时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一张 orders 表,给出字段类型和索引
say.note: 产出带约束和索引的建表 SQL

say.text: 审查这份 PostgreSQL 建表语句,指出类型和索引问题
say.note: 按规则逐条核对类型、约束与索引

say.text: 这张表有 1 亿行,该怎么分区?
say.note: 按分区键和查询方式给出分区方案

howto.what_en: Claude applies this skill when designing or reviewing a PostgreSQL schema: it suggests column types, keys, constraints, indexes and partitioning, and produces ready-to-run DDL.
howto.when_en: Use it when you ask to design a new PostgreSQL schema, review an existing one, or choose types, indexes or partitioning.

say_en.text: Design an orders table for me with column types and indexes
say_en.note: Returns DDL with constraints and indexes

say_en.text: Review this PostgreSQL DDL and flag type and index issues
say_en.note: Checks types, constraints and indexes against the rules

say_en.text: This table has 100M rows — how should I partition it?
say_en.note: Suggests a partitioning scheme from the access pattern
